_comment: Canonical Aether event registry — DO NOT manually edit. Source of truth for packages/shared/events.ts and generated_registry.py. Edit here, then run: python scripts/generate_contracts.py

_registryNotes.runtime_domain_commerce: Dotted commerce.* event types (commerce.order.created, commerce.cart.updated, ...) live in the runtime domain, NOT in this registry, mirroring the comms precedent. WS4 of the UPR follow-on program tracks this split (tracker-only); the merge stays deferred to a dedicated convergence program. No EventType-union edits here.

events.description: Page/screen view from aether.pageView() + SPA hooks
Session liveness heartbeat from session manager
Journey paused by user or system
Permitted click expected to navigate; carries navigation ID and sanitized destination for intent/arrival correlation
Page or SPA route arrival correlated to a prior navigation_intent by navigation ID
Native deep link opened; carries canonical acquisition evidence (destination domain, aether_ref, UTM, click IDs)
First app launch attributed via platform install evidence (Play Install Referrer or verified handoff)
Pending pre-install source handoff deterministically reconciled after first launch
Host app decoded a QR code; the decoded URL is parsed through the canonical acquisition-evidence parser (entry method qr_code)
Host app read an NFC tag URI; the URI is parsed through the canonical acquisition-evidence parser (entry method nfc)
iOS App Clip invocation URL observed and parsed through the canonical acquisition-evidence parser; first-touch persisted for full-app handoff
Consent state change — always allowed regardless of consent state
Agent delegated task to another agent
Agent handed off to another system
Reward eligibility action queued — emitted by Aether, not the tenant
Agent OTP detected (structural metadata only, not the OTP value)
x402 resource request observed from external perspective
Content item was displayed to the user
Recommendation was displayed to the user
Offer was presented to the user
Product feature was exposed to the user
Search result was shown to the user
Advertisement was displayed to the user
System decision presented to or observed by user
User or agent achieved a defined goal
User or agent failed to achieve a goal
Human overrode an agent or system recommendation
Member invited to organization or workspace
Member removed from organization or workspace
Service account created (reference only, not credentials)
API key created (key ID reference only)
Dunning process started for failed payment
Dead click observed (DOM-level, web only auto-capture)
Rage click observed (multiple rapid clicks, web only auto-capture)
Form interaction started (structural metadata only — no values)
Form field interaction (field type and metadata only — no entered values)
Form validation failed (category and count, not values)
Search query reformulated (hash/category, not raw query)
User backtracked to a previous step
Actor entered a surface (route, screen, view, modal, API surface)
Actor exited a surface; closes the surface interval
Canonical interaction on a control (typed via the interaction vocabulary)
Native UI control interaction observed by the SDK (metadata-only: stable control id, type, action, screen; no control text unless explicitly enabled)
Feature usage reached its defined completion
Domain action attempted (interaction truth, not outcome truth)
Domain action reported success by its owning system
Domain action reported failure by its owning system
Bounded active/visible/idle interval evidence for a surface
API request observed from server-side (no request/response body)
Agent inference or tool cost observed
AI model invocation observed — identity, usage, cost, latency, quality, and outcome correlation; no raw prompt or completion content
Human override of agent action observed
Transaction affected by chain reorg observed
Email accepted by provider queue (lifecycle state)
Email handed to recipient MTA by provider
Email delivery deferred by recipient MTA
Email dropped by provider before send
Inbound human reply to a sent email
Send suppressed by provider suppression list
Message received (structural metadata only — no content)
Message sent (structural metadata only — no content)
Credit signal observed — requires explicit credit opt-in
Credit account state observed — requires explicit credit opt-in
Credit decision observed — requires explicit credit opt-in. Host-observed only; Aether does not make credit decisions.
Location observation — requires explicit location opt-in
Geofence entry/exit — requires explicit location opt-in
Trading account connected to Aether observation — requires financial_activity opt-in
Trading account disconnected from Aether observation — requires financial_activity opt-in
Trading account explicitly authorized for read-only observation — requires financial_activity opt-in
Trading account deauthorized; observation ceases — requires financial_activity opt-in
Agent enabled for a trading account — requires financial_activity and agent opt-in
Agent disabled on a trading account — requires financial_activity and agent opt-in
Trade intent created by agent or human — observation only; execution_by_aether is always false
Human approval requested before trade execution — observation only
Human trade approval approved or rejected — observation only
Risk policy updated for a trading account — requires financial_activity opt-in
Human manually overrode an agent trade decision — observation only; execution_by_aether is always false

Stablecoin payment observed (transfer classified as payment)

Stablecoin withdrawal from a venue observed

Holder concentration metric observed for a deployment

Message dispatch observed on source network
